correctness.rationale: The equations and critical parameter values are those in the originating paper. Its difference of two logistic terms equals −tanh(β(x−T)/2). Write A=g(p)P(p)/ε and D=−r*(1−r*)H′(p), both positive; the linearized off-diagonal entries are A,−D and the frequency is √(AD). The real linear change V=−√(A/D)(r−r*) yields the usual positive rotation. At p the affine dependence of the first component on r and H(p)=H″(p)=0 eliminate all cubic focus terms except f_UUU+f_UV f_UU/ω. The remaining factor f_UV/ω=−g′(p)/g(p) leaves r*/ε times gP‴+2g′P″. Logarithmic differentiation gives P″(p)/P(p)=−n/g(p) and P‴(p)/P(p)=2n g′(p)/g(p)², so the coefficient is exactly zero independent of amplitude/time conventions. In the balanced case, parity of g,P and oddness of H give the stated reflection reversibility for both laws. Dividing the first-coordinate displacement from the reflection line by the initial transverse-section displacement gives at zero a nonzero multiple of sin(ωt), and hence a transverse near-half-period crossing by the implicit-function theorem. Reversibility at the two fixed-line points closes the orbit. Near the equilibrium in rotation coordinates the angular speed stays bounded away from zero; sufficiently small trajectories remain small for one rotation and cross the line, so these closed orbits fill a punctured neighborhood. This is an exact local result, not a conclusion from numerical l₁ magnitudes or computations of a few cycles.
residual_risks: The scripted endpoints and reported sub-5×10⁻¹³ errors were not replayed; script tolerances themselves do not certify that bound, which is ancillary to the proof.

originality.rationale: Demonstrable coverage of both parts of the frozen claim, not an inference from similar titles or a claim about historical priority. The distinct indexed Resultary record 7e6e32e0b3b7 explicitly proves the all-quota zero cubic coefficient and the balanced nonlinear center for exactly the same sigmoid model, equilibrium condition and critical normalization. The distinct indexed record caf974f7f068 gives a first integral with a nondegenerate minimum and a nonlinear center for the identical critical linear model at every admissible quota. There the linear cubic coefficient vanishes as a necessary consequence of a center, and the balanced linear center is a special case. Together these two checked statements cover the full model-specific finding. Both indexed entries are dated later than the frozen record; this is a statement-level equivalence/implication assessment, not a finding that they historically preceded it or were its sources. The earlier Liu–Chen–Szolnoki article does not give the exact cancellation and in fact reports tiny nonzero negative numerical coefficients.
residual_risks: This failure is demonstrable mathematical coverage in reviewed distinct indexed findings; no conclusion about who first derived or published the result.

value.rationale: The exact diagnosis of tiny numerical signs and the distinction between a nonlinear center and a supercritical Hopf are scientifically meaningful questions. But the frozen contribution contains no distinct needed invariant or open-case resolution after the checked stronger analytical results: the linear system is locally integrable at all quotas and the full frozen sigmoid contribution is already stated and proved at the same parameters. Combining their conclusions in one calculation is useful exposition, not a surviving independently valuable new result under the acceptance standard. In particular the asymmetric sigmoid higher-order dynamics and the unfolding remain outside the finding.
residual_risks: This assesses the contribution in the checked corpus, not the importance of correcting the original paper or historical priority. No substantive repaired remainder was established.
